title: Bow aim experiment: four ways to widen (L-O)
intro: In the Camera Distance menu, UNTICK 'Limit the bow-aim zoom' first so it doesn't interfere. Stand with a clear view. You'll hold the bow aim for about 25 s. Remember which letters changed the view.

steps.text: Co-op OFF. Now HOLD the bow aim (right mouse) and keep holding it until the end. Press End while aiming

steps.each_frame:
if not AIMX then
  AIMX = { mode = "", n = {} }
  local root = sdk.find_type_definition("app.PlayerCameraControllerRoot")
  local function hook(name, post)
    local m = root:get_method(name)
    if not m then AIMX["missing_" .. name] = true return end
    sdk.hook(m, function(args) thread.get_hook_storage().this = sdk.to_managed_object(args[2]) end,
      function(ret)
        pcall(function()
          local o = thread.get_hook_storage().this
          local tn = o:get_type_definition():get_name()
          AIMX.n[name .. ":" .. tn] = (AIMX.n[name .. ":" .. tn] or 0) + 1
          if tn == "AimCameraController" then post(o) end
        end)
        return ret
      end)
  end
  hook("updatePog", function(o)
    if AIMX.mode == "L" then o:set_field("_Fov", 90.0) end
  end)
  hook("updatePosition", function(o)
    if AIMX.mode == "M" then o:set_field("_Fov", 90.0) end
    if AIMX.mode == "N" then
      local p, g = o:get_field("_Position"), o:get_field("_Pog")
      local dx, dy, dz = p.x - g.x, p.y - g.y, p.z - g.z
      local l = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
      if l > 0.01 then p.x, p.y, p.z = p.x + dx / l * 3.0, p.y + dy / l * 3.0, p.z + dz / l * 3.0; o:set_field("_Position", p) end
    end
  end)
end

probes.ctrl: local mc=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0); local c=mc:call('get_CurrentCameraController'); return c and (c:get_type_definition():get_name()..' '..tostring(c:call('get_BaseDistance'))) or 'nil'
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.cfov: local mc=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0); local c=mc:call('get_CurrentCameraController'); return c and c:get_field('_Fov')
probes.calls: local t={} for k,v in pairs(AIMX and AIMX.n or {}) do t[#t+1]=k..'='..v end table.sort(t) return table.concat(t,' ')
